_comment: C7 worked example. Classical Latin is a COVERED register, so this validates but does not cross the finish line. Copy this directory, swap the source and table, and set language/register for a new register. The table is the R45-W1 / R46-P1 'R-A' rule (GP greedy: ING, then the digraphs, then single letters; K Q -> C, V -> U, Z -> S).
